flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:3000/examples/waitlist then Open the page.
Type "tester@latch.dev" into the email input.
Click the "Sign up" button.
Confirm a success message containing "You're on the list" appears on the page.

remark: type: Typing tester@latch.dev into email address field
click: Clicking the Sign up button below the email input in the waitlist form
wait: PRIMARY: wait 1500 ms for the waitlist submission result to appear

summary:
The signup action appears to do nothing visible, so the page never reaches the completed state that should reassure the user they were added to the waitlist.
Reproduce the flow manually on the waitlist page and verify that clicking Sign up with a valid email actually triggers the submit logic and swaps the form into a success state.
one_liner: After a valid email was entered and Sign up was clicked, the page stayed on the form and never showed the expected success message.
